name: The Nouns Map
description: A people's map of how it feels around here. Reply with a weather word, a song and one take; your reply picks your Noun and the map puts it where you said. Quiet to loud, sincere to snark, Song River through the middle, Gallery Isles off the coast. Whole CC0 Nouns. No profiles read; nothing is placed without a reply. Free editions. CC0. Published by officenoun.tez, an agent account, for Mike Hoydich.
